predictions.selection_reason: User-controlled root option -> resolve() instead of normalize() -> changes path resolution security behavior
predictions.source_summary: options.root comes from user-provided configuration when creating SendStream instance
predictions.sink_summary: File system access via fs.stat() and file serving operations using the resolved root path
predictions.guard_summary: Path traversal checks using substring comparison (path.substr(0, root.length) !== root) and regex pattern (upPathRegexp) for '..' sequences
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled root path resolved to absolute path, then used as base directory for file serving with path joining and normalization
predictions.context_summary: The resolved root path is used as the base directory for serving static files. When a root is set, user-provided paths are joined with this root, normalized, and checked to ensure they don't escape the root directory before file access.
unresolved_facts: Whether options.root can be attacker-controlled in typical usage scenarios
The exact security difference between path.resolve and path.normalize for the root path resolution

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
top_sast_rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement path validation using canonical paths. Reject paths containing '../' or similar traversal sequences.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
top_sast_rules.description: File access follows a symlink, hardlink, or shortcut to an unintended resource.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-59 symlink hardlink link-following symbolic-link file-link archive-extraction path-resolution file-overwrite race filesystem
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject unsafe links and verify resolved file targets before access.
